author: pk910
content:
We've launched glamsterdam-devnet-11 a few minutes ago:
https://dora.glamsterdam-devnet-11.ethpandaops.io/

This is a small network intended to run through the fork transition without problems so L2s, staking pools and other entities can test the happy case upgrade path. So we won't hit it with heavy transition testing as last time.
Gloas is scheduled for Monday 14th, 10:00 UTC.
We'll keep it up for a few weeks,  please give us a note if you anyone needs it up for longer.
